raw.room_reading: The room is a square with four equal walls, each 4100 mm long. There are two windows on Wall 1 and two on Wall 2. The floor area is 172 sqft, and the wall height is 2500 mm. The customer wants a U-shaped layout, tall storage, and base shutt
raw.design_plan: I will design a U-shaped kitchen with the hob on Wall 1 and the sink on Wall 2. I will use base shutters for the majority of the base cabinets and place the two tall units above the sink and hob. The壁
raw.layout_why: This layout maximizes storage space and provides easy access to the hob and sink. The U-shape allows for efficient workflow and utilizes the available space well.
raw.sink_why: The customer chose Wall 2 for the sink, so it will be placed here.
raw.hob_why: The customer wants the hob on Wall 1, so it will be placed here.
raw.lpg_why: LPG is assumed by the customer, so the cylinder unit will be included.
raw.tall_why: The customer wants two tall units, so they will be placed above the sink and hob.
raw.purifier_why: The customer did not specify a water purifier, so it will be included in the design.
raw.display_why: The customer did not specify a glass display, so it will be included in the design.
raw.open_why: The customer did not specify an open shelf unit, so it will be included in the design.
raw.storage_why: The customer wants tall storage, so the tall units will be included.
raw.features_why: No specific feature units were requested, so the base and tall units will be standard.
raw.wall_cabinets_why: The customer did not specify wall cabinet sizes, so I will choose standard sizes.
raw.wall_style_why: The customer did not specify a wall style, so I will choose hinged shutters.
raw.finish_why: The customer did not specify finishes, so I will choose the standard finishes.
raw.loft_why: Lofts were not specified, so they will be included above the wall cabinets.
